title: Annual data on economic and military characteristics of 78 nations, 1948-1983
authors: Faber, J., Rijksuniversiteit Utrecht * Utrecht, Vakgroep Gamma-informatica (primary investigator)
descriptions: An empirical basis for the Sire model: simulation of international relations for Europe. Statistics of 78 countries for each year during the period of 1948-1983: consumer price index, exchange rate of national currency to US dollar, total exports and imports, government revenues and expenditures, capital formation, defence expenditures, GNP, population and total military personnel.
